mapper.select: select s.admin_user_id as adminUserId,s.liaison as adminName,s.phone as adminPhone,s.id,s.name,s.phone,s.liaison,c.`code` from supplier s left join `cube-biz-meattrade`.meattrade_vip_card c on s.id = c.supplier_id LEFT JOIN supplier_authentication sa ON s.id = sa.supplier_id where sa.STATUS = 'CERTIFIED' and s.tenant = ${param.tenant} and (s.`name` like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%") or s.liaison like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%") or s.phone like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%") or c.`code` like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%")) UNION ALL select u.id as adminUserId,u.name as adminName,u.mobile as adminPhone,null,null,null,null,null from purchaser p INNER JOIN `cube-biz-ouaa`.`user` u on p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN purchaser_authentication pa ON p.id = pa.purchaser_id where pa.STATUS = 'CERTIFIED' and p.tenant = ${param.tenant} and (u.`name` like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%") or u.mobile like concat("%",#{param.keyword},"%"))
